::: {#exr-oak-type-mug}
Fix these commands so that they store the numbers properly.

```{webr}
#| caption: Fixing names
#| min-lines: 5
1st_place_score <- 103
first day <- Sys.Date() + 20
second-day <- Sys.Date() + 21
```

<!-- Opening answer: otm-2MS -->
::: {.callout-tip collapse=true `r devoirs:::answer_style()`}
## Answer
The problem in each case is with the name on the left-hand side of the storage arrow.

i. Names must start with a character. So, `first_place_score` would be a sensible replacement, as would `place_1_score`.
ii. Spaces are not allowed in names. By convention, an underscore (`-`) is used to separate words in names: `first_day`.
iii. Hyphens are not allowed in names. Use an underscore instead: `second_day`.
